title: analytics: the duplicate-column refusal tells a dataset author to "give one of the group entries its own alias", which a dataset selection cannot do
body:
domain:server#3 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5kE5BrPUPNMMyv6oCH

Blocked-by: PR #28794

Filing gate: ① should-fix 2 of the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review `6563360371` on PR #28794 (#28765), read in the tree, not measured live. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim.

Reach: a dataset query that names one column twice in its groups is refused with `INVALID_QUERY` / 400 by the objectql engine's duplicate-column door. Examples are a column raw beside its own bucket, or two buckets of one column. Native declines granularity selections to the ObjectQL strategy, so both live faces reach that door. After PR #28794 the draft preview copies the same message. The message's remedy reads "Give one of the group entries its own 'alias'". A dataset selection (`dimensions` / `timeDimensions`) has no alias, so the author cannot make that repair on any face.

## Wanted

When the refusal reaches a dataset caller, its prescription names a repair the author can make. For example: drop the raw dimension, or ask for one granularity of the column. Keep the same `code` and `status`. Keep the engine's alias prescription for a direct objectql caller who can alias. Update the preview copy (PR #28794's `preview-group-column-door.ts`) and its parity pin in the same change.

## Dedupe

Read open issues for `own alias`, `duplicate groupBy` and `INVALID_QUERY group`: only #28765 (the preview parity this rides on). **New.**

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (`packages/services/service-analytics`, with `packages/objectql` only if the prescription must move at the door).

Links back: #28765, PR #28794, #28744
